text:
Alex: Morning — quick async standup from me. What I did: finished the rollout gating spec draft and paired with infra to wire up the health check. Blockers: can't reproduce the intermittent 502s in staging; need the last canary logs and the image tag used. Today: want reviews on the spec + aim to run a canary by noon PT. @Sam @Jordan please eyeball the gating thresholds.

Maria: Thanks Alex. I pushed the spec PR (#987) with a short changelog. TL;DR: require 99.5% successful responses over 5m and automatic rollback on 3 consecutive 5m windows. Also added a short UI copy suggestion. Link: https://git.redwood/pr/987 :eyes:

Sam: I can review this afternoon. Quick note: cache invalidation could cause transient 5xxs when we flip the router. Suggest adding a warmup step and increasing KV ttl during rollout. Example snippet for the warmup job config:

```
job: canary-warmup
concurrency: 4
retries: 2
warmup_keys: ["/kv/model/*"]
```

I'll add the suggestion in the PR comments.

Jordan: Can run the canary at 12:05 PT once Lina pushes the image. I'll watch latency and error rates and post early signals here. If we see error rate >0.5% for 2 consecutive minutes I'll abort.

Lina: Pushing image now: r-infer:v2026-03-17-rc3. Also updated the rollout README with the warmup step and a debugging checklist. Docs: https://docs.redwood/internal/rollouts/canary. Left a short note in the PR about the image tag.

Alex: Great — blocker for me is product sign-off on wording in the UI modal. @Maria did you finalize the copy?

Maria: Yup — updated the wording in the spec and the UX note. Changed "Predictable inference" to "Predictable latency and throughput" (small tweak). Considered keeping shorter text, but product is good with this.

Sam: Reviewed PR, left two nits around log level and a missing metric label. None are blocking. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started (canary id: c-2410008000) — image r-infer:v2026-03-17-rc3. Health check target: 99.5% over 5m. Logs: https://logs.redwood/c-2410008000

Jordan: Early look at the first 90s: CPU and token latency look fine, small 502 spike at 00:01:30 into the canary — digging into backend traces now. If the spike is just cache warmup we can ignore.

Lina: I pulled the trace — looks like a downstream db connection retry. Added a fallback to the DB client in the branch. Pushing a patch to the canary image now (v2026-03-17-rc3b), ETA 6m.

Alex: OK — let's hold on the feature flag cut until the rc3b canary finishes. If rc3b is clean we'll do a 10% flag tomorrow morning. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Ping here if anything blocks.

Sam: Will re-check after rc3b finishes.

Jordan: Watching.

Maria: Thanks team — product sign-off logged.

Alex: Closing my update. If you need me I'm around; ping me directly for urgent stuff. :raised_hands:
